Beyblade Burst.name: Beyblade Burst
Beyblade Burst.summary: Beyblade Burst (Japanese: ベイブレードバースト, Beiburēdo Bāsuto) is a Beyblade handheld video game for the Nintendo 3DS published by FuRyu. It was released on November 10, 2016 in Japan.

Cocoto - Alien Brick Breaker.name: Cocoto Alien Brick Breaker
Cocoto - Alien Brick Breaker.summary: Cocoto bounces balls off alien invaders or something.

Peanuts Movie, The - Snoopy's Grand Adve.name: The Peanuts Movie: Snoopy's Grand Adventure
Peanuts Movie, The - Snoopy's Grand Adve.summary: Take Snoopy on a grand adventure through environments, created by his imagination, as he tries to find Charlie Brown and all his friends. With Woodstock and the Beagle Scouts by his side Snoopy can unlock new abilities and performs special moves as he weaves his way through this magical journey.

Starry Sky - In Winter 3D.name: Starry Sky: in Winter 3D
Starry Sky - In Winter 3D.summary: Starry Sky: in Winter 3D is a port of Starry Sky: in Winter for the 3DS.
